result.notes: Changed requires_unknown_facts from true to false. Chapter 260 covers ordinary rental buildings of 5 or more units. Its other exemptions, which owners claim by request, cannot be checked by address lookup, so they belong in unverifiable_exemptions; they do not limit the rule to a class of buildings that assessor data cannot identify. min_units=5 is inferred from the page's statement that all 1-4 unit properties are exempt. No construction-date, owner-occupancy or new-construction limits appear in the captured source. DX02, DX04, DX06 and DX11 concern the separate algorithmic rent-fixing ordinance (§218-12) and do not bear on Chapter 260 coverage.
